metadata.name: Rainbow Comet Cursor
metadata.description: A canvas-based custom cursor that trails a glowing, hue-cycling rainbow comet tail behind the mouse, with a glow boost on hoverable elements and a radial rainbow spark burst on click.
metadata.author: felix-au
